name: Devid Striesow
bio:
Devid Striesow (born October 1, 1973 in Bergen auf Rügen) is a German actor. He starred as "Sturmbannführer Herzog" (Bernhard Krüger) in Stefan Ruzowitzky's 2007 film The Counterfeiters, which was awarded the Academy Award for Best Foreign Language Film for that year. 2022 Devid got his biggest role so far which is General Friedrichs in «All Quiet On The Western Front»
